events.task: Check whether a cracked green bin can be replaced through an online request
events.report:
Yes. The City accepts bin repair/replacement requests online at toronto.example.com/311 (Service Request > Solid Waste > Bin Repair).
- Lid cracks count as a repair; no charge.
- You'll need the bin's serial number (sticker under the front lip).
- Typical turnaround: 7-10 business days, they swap the lid on site.
You can skip the phone call if you have the serial number handy.
